text: yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . abhippavuṭṭhāni appakasireneva paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti . evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvayato ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroto appakasireneva saññojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti . [289] kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvayato ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroto appakasireneva saññojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti . idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti .pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno
